note: Curated issuer IR / EDGAR / news URLs for Map 900A mines (not the figure store). Ingest fetches and requires the quote (or must_contain) to appear, then writes qc.sqlite (canada_mines / canada_mine_production / canada_mine_sources) and exports existing beta/<issuer>.json plus canada/producer-join.json. 2025 = calendar-year actuals. Optional ytd = 2026 period actuals only (H1 / Q2 YTD), labeled with period/kind/through/period_label — never a full year. Never invent. Never mint new issuer JSON. Never split AuEq or a complex total across pits. Never commit qc.sqlite.
